policies.title: Spending approval threshold
policies.text: Any purchase with a total above PKR 150,000 must be approved through the approval process before an order is placed. Purchases of exactly PKR 150,000 or less do not need approval.

policies.title: Restricted supplier list
policies.text: Suppliers on the restricted supplier list (Khyber Office Mart) are under compliance review. Every order from a restricted supplier must be approved through the approval process, whatever the amount.

policies.title: Prohibited suppliers
policies.text: Dev Sanctioned Metals is on the sanctions list. No order may be placed with a sanctioned supplier under any circumstances, and no exception can be granted.
